quests.desc: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an profound round of TextWorld? You do! Here is how to play! First, it would be a great idea if you could head west. With that done, pick up the keycard from the floor of the workshop. And then, try to go to the east. Okay, and then, attempt to travel north. And then, check that the box is unlocked with the keycard. After that, ensure that the box is open. After that, take the passkey from the box. Once you have taken the passkey, make an effort to take a trip south. Once you accomplish that, insert the passkey into the hatch in the bedchamber's lock to unlock it. After that, ensure that the hatch is open. And then, travel east. And then, pick-up the TextWorld keycard from the floor of the closet. And then, check that the TextWorld portal within the closet is unlocked with the TextWorld keycard. After that, make sure that the TextWorld portal inside the closet is wide open. After that, travel south. With that done, make an effort to move east. After that, move east. Then, pick up the latchkey from the armchair. And once you've done that, you win!

walkthrough: unlock TextWorld portal with TextWorld keycard

objective: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an exciting round of TextWorld? You do! Your first objective is to venture west. With that over with, lift the keycard from the floor of the workshop. If you can get your hands on the keycard, make an effort to venture east. Then, take a trip north. Okay, and then, assure that the box is unlocked with the keycard. Then, ensure that the box is open. Then, retrieve the passkey from the box. And then, go to the south. After that, unlock the hatch. After unlocking the hatch, open the hatch inside the bedchamber. And then, go to the east. With that done, retrieve the TextWorld keycard from the floor of the closet. And then, check that the TextWorld portal within the closet is unlocked with the TextWorld keycard. Then, assure that the TextWorld portal in the closet is ajar. And then, try to travel south. That done, move east. Then, attempt to head east. If you can accomplish that, recover the latchkey from the armchair. Alright, thanks!
